44075.meaning1: endeavours; tries; works; tries to achieve (something for)
44075.commentary: (VINa) alābhāya parisakkatī'ti yathā lābhaṃ na labhanti, evaṃ parakkamati. anatthāyā'ti upaddavāya. avāsāyā'ti kin'ti imasmiṃ āvāse na vaseyyun'ti parakkamati.

examples.text: bhikkhūnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati, bhikkhūnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati, bhikkhūnaṃ avāsāya parisakkati, bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati, bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vibhedeti, buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.

44077.meaning1: gathering of the dregs; assembly of rubbish

examples.text: ye keci kāmesu asaññatā janā, adhammikā honti adhammagāravā, chandā ca dosā ca bhayā ca gāmino, parisakkasāvo ca pan'esa vuccati.

44080.meaning1: entered a meeting; amidst an assembly; in company

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana, bho gotama, parisagato samāno añjaliṃ paggaṇheyyaṃ, āsanā me taṃ bhavaṃ gotamo paccuṭṭhānaṃ dhāretu.

44081.meaning1: gone to a meeting; gone to assembly

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho
saṅghaṃ, bhante, pavāremi diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā. vadantu maṃ āyasmanto anukampaṃ upādāya. passanto paṭikarissāmi

44085.commentary: (MNa) parisaṅkitaṃ nāma diṭṭhaparisaṅkitaṃ sutaparisaṅkitaṃ tadubhaya-vimutta-parisaṅkitan'ti tividhaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tīhi kho ahaṃ, jīvaka, ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ aparibhogan'ti vadāmi. diṭṭhaṃ, sutaṃ, parisaṅkitaṃ, imehi kho ahaṃ, jīvaka, tīhi ṭhānehi maṃsaṃ aparibhogan'ti vadāmi.

44088.meaning1: who knows assemblies; who is familiar with gatherings; (comm) knowing the eight assemblies

examples.text: satta sappurisadhammā, idh'āvuso, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaññū ca.

44090.grammar: fem, loc sg of parisā, irreg
44090.meaning1: in assembly; in meeting; in forum; in gathering

examples.text: so ārāmagato parisati dhammaṃ deseti, na taṃ parisaṃ ussādeti, na taṃ parisaṃ apasādeti, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
assosi kho āyasmā sāriputto sunakkhattassa licchaviputtassa vesāliyaṃ parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa, n'atthi samaṇassa gotamassa uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso.

44092.meaning1: who corrupts a group; who spoils an assembly

examples.text: katame cattāro? bhikkhu, bhikkhave, dussīlo pāpadhammo parisadūsano, bhikkhunī, bhikkhave, dussīlā pāpadhammā parisadūsanā, upāsako, bhikkhave, dussīlo pāpadhammo parisadūsano, upāsikā, bhikkhave, dussīlā pāpadhammā parisadūsanā. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro parisadūsanā.
cattāro parisadūsanā, bhikkhu dussīlo pāpadhammo parisadūsano, bhikkhunī dussīlā pāpadhammā parisadūsanā, upāsako dussīlo pāpadhammo parisadūsano, upāsikā dussīlā pāpadhammā parisadūsanā.

44094.commentary: (DNa) abhisandetī'ti temeti sneheti, sabbattha pavattapītisukhaṃ karoti. parisandetī'ti samantato sandeti. paripūretī'ti vāyunā bhastaṃ viya pūreti. parippharatī'ti samantato phusati.

examples.text: so imam'eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, n'āssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
tāni yāva ca aggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni
tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bādhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.
